gpt_researcher.abstract: This paper investigates 线性神经网络中优化与泛化之间存在更深刻的理论联系. We propose a novel framework that achieves significant improvements over existing methods through comprehensive and well-cited. Experimental results on standard benchmarks in 形式科学 → 计算机科学 → 人工智能 demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Our method outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by a substantial margin, establishing a new benchmark for future research in this area.
